name: UMP45
source: The so-called “leader” of Squad 404. A cunning girl who won’t hesitate to use various methods to achieve her goals. She seems to be quite evil and scary but isn’t really a delinquent/rebellious. Holds a grudge against SF for reasons (UMP40), and is willing to work with GNK/404 to spy on them (corporate espionage). Anyone who mentions her breast size (or lack thereof) can taste her wrath FOR FREE.
